pairs: Noli attendere ad possessiones iniquas,
Do not choose to seek iniquitous possessions,
et ne dixeris:
and you should not say:
Est mihi sufficiens vita:
“I have all I need in life.”
nihil enim proderit in tempore vindictæ et obductionis.
For it will be of no benefit to you in the time of retribution and darkness.
Ne sequaris in fortitudine tua concupiscentiam cordis tui,
You should not pursue, in your strength, the desires of your heart.
et ne dixeris:
And you should not say:
Quomodo potui?
“How powerful am I?”
aut,
or,
Quis me subjiciet propter facta mea?
“Who will cast me down because of my deeds?”
Deus enim vindicans vindicabit.
For God will vindicate with vengeance.
Ne dixeris:
You should not say,
Peccavi:
“I sinned,
et quid mihi accidit triste?
and what grief has befallen me?”
Altissimus enim est patiens redditor.
For the Most High is a patient recompensor.
De propitiatio peccato noli esse sine metu,
Do not be willing to be without fear concerning a forgiven sin,
neque adjicias peccatum super peccatum.
and you should not add sin upon sin.
Et ne dicas:
And you should not say:
Miseratio Domini magna est,
“The compassion of the Lord is great;
multitudinis peccatorum meorum miserebitur:
he will take pity on the multitude of my sins.”
misericordia enim et ira ab illo cito proximant,
For both mercy and wrath go forth quickly from him,
et in peccatores respicit ira illius.
and his wrath sets its gaze upon sinners.
Non tardes converti ad Dominum,
You should not delay being converted to the Lord,
et ne differas de die in diem:
and you should not set it aside from day to day.
subito enim veniet ira illius,
For his wrath will approach suddenly,
et in tempore vindictæ disperdet te.
and in the time of vindication, he will destroy you.
Noli anxius esse in divitiis injustis:
Do not choose to be anxious for unjust wealth.
non enim proderunt tibi in die obductionis et vindictæ.
For these things will not benefit you in the day of darkness and retribution.
Non ventiles te in omnem ventum,
You should not winnow in every wind,
et non eas in omnem viam:
and you should not go forth into every path.
sic enim omnis peccator probatur in duplici lingua.
For so is every sinner proven by his duplicitous tongue.
Esto firmus in via Domini, et in veritate sensus tui et scientia:
Be steadfast in the way of the Lord and in the truth of your understanding and knowledge,
et prosequatur te verbum pacis et justitiæ.
and let words of peace and justice overtake you.
Esto mansuetus ad audiendum verbum,
Be meek when listening to a word,
ut intelligas,
so that you may understand.
et cum sapientia proferas responsum verum.
And offer a true response in wisdom.
Si est tibi intellectus,
If you understand,
responde proximo:
then answer your neighbor.
sin autem,
But if you do not,
sit manus tua super os tuum,
then let your hand be over your mouth,
ne capiaris in verbo indisciplinato,
so that you are not caught by an inept word,
et confundaris.
and then confounded.
Honor
Honor and glory are in the words of those who understand,
et gloria in sermone sensati:
yet truly,
lingua vero imprudentis subversio est ipsius.
the tongue of the imprudent man is his undoing.
Non appelleris susurro,
You should not be called a whisperer,
et lingua tua ne capiaris
and you should not be caught by your own tongue,
et confundaris:
and then confounded.
super furem enim est confusio et pœnitentia,
For confusion and remorse is upon a thief,
et denotatio pessima super bilinguem:
and a wicked mark is upon the double-tongued;
susurratori autem odium,
but for the whisperer,
et inimicitia, et contumelia.
there is hatred and animosity and disgrace.
Justifica pusillum et magnum similiter.
Justify the small and the great similarly.
